==Background==
"'''Mx.Nihil'''", or "'''Mr.nihil'''" for the VOCALOID version, is an original song produced by ¿?shimon. It was commissioned for the unit {{IW|projectsekai|25-ji, Nightcord de.}} from the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

Both the 25-ji, Nightcord de. version and the VOCALOID version of the song have entered the ''[[Hall of Fame]]'' on Niconico, while their YouTube uploads have exceeded 8 million views and 2 million views respectively.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
The VOCALOID version of the song was featured on the single ''虚無さん (Nihil-san)''.

The 25-ji, Nightcord de. version of the song was featured on the single ''虚無さん/飾って (Nihil-san/Kazatte)''.

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'' (Virtual Singer version by flower; SEKAI version by 25-ji, Nightcord de. and Kagamine Len).

==Trivia==
*In the 25-ji, Nightcord de. PV, the beginning verse of the music video shows a questionaire that reads the following:
**Question 1: What is your future aspiration?<br>"I don't know."
**Question 2: What do you like?<br>"I don't know."
**Question 3: What do you dislike?<br>"I don't know."
**Question 4: What is love?<br>"I don't know."
*The PV also shows Mafuyu's phone with the notifactions from the other members of Nightcord:
**Nightcord at 25:00, now<br>K (Yoisaki Kanade)<br>1 Notification
**Nightcord at 25:00, now<br>Enanan (Shinonome Ena)<br>1 Notification
**Nightcord at 25:00, now<br>Amia (Akiyama Mizuki)<br>1 Notification
*The phone shows up again in the middle of the PV, but now shows a notification from Mafuyu's mother:
**Mom, now<br>1 Notification<br>Mom, now<br>1 Notification
